name: Boulder
title: Camp Guardian
description: A massive sumo wrestler in white mawashi, standing as an immovable guardian of the refugee camp.
greeting_variants: Camp is safe. Boulder keeps safe. You safe here.
*crosses arms* Strong look weak. Weak look strong. You?
Many try enter. Boulder stop. Every time.
*sniffs* You smell... like fighter. Good. We need.
Boulder was champion. Now Boulder is wall. Both good.
*stomps, ground shakes* Warning to enemies. Comfort to friends.
You small. But small can be mighty. Boulder knows.

dialog_tree.text: Boulder. Camp guardian. Before, ring fighter. Champion! Now... *pats chest* ...different ring. Different fight. Same heart.
*pleased rumble* Thank. Size is gift. But mind is weapon too. Boulder reads people. Watches. Knows who threatens. Who helps. You? *studies you* ...you help. Boulder sees.
Barrelgobs. Sometimes. Void-touched. Rare, but bad. Worst? Desperate people. Hungry. Afraid. They do bad things. Boulder understands. But still stops. Protects those inside.

party_reactions.boulder: Compassion is strength. Boulder knows this.

dialog_tree.text: *eyes light up* Spar? Yes! Boulder miss ring! But... careful. Boulder strong. Even holding back. You sure?

mini_quest.title: Train the Guards
mini_quest.description: Help Boulder train refugee volunteers in basic defense to protect the camp.
objectives: Lead a patrol around the camp perimeter
Report to Vex on trainee progress

ambient_barks: *staring down a barrelgob* Small. Fast. But Boulder patient.
Camp sleeps. Boulder watches. Every night.
*practicing stomps* Train body. Train mind. Both strong.
You need help carrying? Boulder carry much.
*sniffing air* Something wrong. Boulder smells it.
White is pure. Boulder keeps camp pure. Safe.
*gentle voice to child* Little one. Lost? Boulder help find mama.

cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tower has sumo too. Gold one. Royal guard. Boulder heard stories.
cross_zone_references.palace: Boulder guarded Palace once. Long ago. Before tear.
cross_zone_references.ember: Ember has strong fighters. Boulder respects.

kael.response: *formal bow* Captain. Your honor honors you.

world_state_triggers.attack_imminent: Takes defensive position, warns camp: 'Boulder holds. You run if needed.'
world_state_triggers.threat_eliminated: Relaxes slightly, offers healing/rest to party
